subject.title: [Bug]: agents.list tools hot-reload not propagated to telegram channel workers — stale tool policy until full gateway restart (2026.7.1-2)

question: For live changes to `agents.list[].tools`, should OpenClaw guarantee in-place propagation to active channel workers, or intentionally require a managed gateway restart when that propagation cannot be completed safely?
rationale: The report establishes an inconsistency but leaves two valid product contracts with different availability and operational tradeoffs; source inspection and a reproduction should inform the implementation, but maintainers must choose the intended reload guarantee.

options.title: Propagate worker snapshots
options.body: Refresh the affected channel-worker agent runtime before its next inbound turn and add a regression test proving Telegram and fresh runtime behavior agree after reload.

options.title: Require managed restart
options.body: Classify per-agent tool-policy changes as restart-required and surface that state clearly so operators do not mistake a partial hot reload for completed application.

recommendation.title: Propagate worker snapshots
recommendation.body: Refresh the affected channel-worker agent runtime before its next inbound turn and add a regression test proving Telegram and fresh runtime behavior agree after reload.

likelyOwner.reason: A source and history pass is needed to identify the concrete reload-plan and channel-worker owners without guessing.
